findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Observed employee to fail to use a barrier to turn off hand sink. Educated employee on proper hand washing procedure. Ensure employees are properly washing hands prior to starting a new task or donning new gloves.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed facility to have no sanitizer buckets created during operation. Sanitizer was made in the triple sink for dishwashing, but there were no cloths present for sanitizing food contact surfaces such as prep tables, etc. Staff created a sanitizer bucket on site, so the violation is considered COS. Ensure there is a sanitizer bucket with cloths at all times to incentivize staff to properly sanitize food contact surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed nozzles of lemonade and tea dispensers to be soiled. Informed staff that nozzles need to be cleaned frequently to avoid accumulation of soil and debris. A follow-up is scheduled for 3/17/2025 to ensure the dispenser nozzles are clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Observed jugs of water and cans of soda stored on the floor in and around the walk-in drink cooler. Informed staff that food must be stored at least 6 inches off the floor. Proper food storage prevents the accumulation of pests in the facility as well as protects food items from cross-contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed hood in kitchen to be soiled with dust and grease. Informed staff that hood needs to be cleaned frequently to avoid dust and grease from falling into cooking food. Ensure hood is cleaned either in-house or by a third party company by next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment: Observed mop bucket to contain old soiled mop water. Informed staff that all waste water must be properly removed from facility and can never be left overnight. Staff emptied mop bucket while on site. Ensure mop bucket is emptied immediately after use and waste water is not being retained in facility.
findings.citation_text: 5-402.13 Conveying Sewage. SEWAGE shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed both hand sinks in kitchen as well as mop sink to not be properly sealed to wall. Ensure sinks are sealed to wall using a sealant such as caulking to avoid moisture retention between the sink and wall. Repairs should be completed prior to next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.comment: Observed ventilation in bathroom to be inoperable and hanging from ceiling. Informed staff that bathrooms require adequate ventilation to keep room free of excessive vapors, obnoxious odors, fumes, and heat. Ensure ventilation is repairs prior to next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-304.11 Mechanical. If necessary to keep rooms free of excessive heat, steam, condensation, vapors, obnoxious odors, smoke, and fumes, mechanical ventilation of sufficient capacity shall be provided.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.comment: Observed employee drink without lid stored with food in dry storage room. Informed staff that a designated area is needed for employee drinks to avoid cross-contamination. Ensure a designated area is used for employee food/drink prior to next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-403.11(A) Designated Areas. (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use TOBACCO PRODUCTS shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed no paper towels available for use at hand sink located next to 3 compartment sink in kitchen. Paper towels were provided during inspection. 

6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
Observed swinging gate dividing kitchen and retail store to have several pieces of duct taped attached. Remove duct tape or replace swing gate. 

4-101.19: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed floors underneath shelving and equipment in kitchen to be soiled with debris. Pull shelving and equipment away from wall, and clean floors. 

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed soda fountain counter to be soiled with soda syrup and food debris. Clean and sanitize soda fountain counter

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed several ceiling tiles in lobby to be soiled with black mold. Clean and sanitize ceiling tiles to remove black mold. 

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. 
Observed employee wash hands and then proceed to turn off the faucet handle with bare hands. The employee was coached immediately and rewashed hands properly.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
3-304.14: (A) Cloths in-use for wiping FOOD spills for TABLEWARE and carryout containers shall be dry and used for no other purpose. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. (C) Cloths in-use for wiping raw animal FOOD surfaces shall be separate from other cloths. (D) Dry wiping cloths and sanitizing solution shall be free of FOOD debris and other soil. (E) Containers of sanitizing solution shall be stored off floor and used in manner to prevent contamination. (F) SINGLE-USE disposable sanitizer wipes shall be used in accordance with EPA labels. 
A wet wiping cloth is observed to be sitting on the rail of the pizza prep table. The soiled wet wiping cloth was placed into laundry. Take care to properly store wet wiping cloths when finished using them.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-903.11: (A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination. 
Observed a box of 30oz single use Jcups stored on the floor in the back hall. Store single service items properly protected.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. 
The front of the soda fountain/drink station is sticky with soda residue. The area around the single use lid storage is heavily soiled. Clean and maintain clean.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment: 2-301.14: Observed food employee put on new pair of gloves without first washing hands.  Wash hands before each new glove use. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.comment: 3-101.11: Observed moldy tomatoes in walk in cooler.  Tomatoes were discarded. FOOD shall be safe, unADULTERATED, and, honestly presented.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 4-602.13: Observed soft serve ice cream machine to be soiled with dried ice cream residue.  NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: 6-501.16: Observed mop head to be stored head down in dirty mop water bucket. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: No bare hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed
findings.citation_text:
3-301.11 (Pf) Food employee is not minimizing bare hand contact with foods that are not in a ready to eat form. Employee shall use suitable utensils or gloves to minimize bare hand contact with these foods. Reference 3-301.11.
Observed employee to place two large tea bags in the filter basket and mash them down with her bare hands. The tea brews but the temperature of the tea bags only reached 85F. Handle tea bags like the ready to eat products they are by protecting them from contact with bare hands. Employee and manager were coached.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11  (Pf) Hand washing sink blocked by a stack of soda boxes and other soda. The soad was immediately moved to a proper storage locatio. Hand washing sinks must be accessible at all times. Reference 5-205.11. Do not block hand sinks.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A)  (Pf) Observed the nozzles of the soad fountian to be soield with mold in the areation holes. These areation devices are food contact surfaces. Wash, rinse, sanitize food-contact surfaces routinely. Reference 4-601.11(A). Avoid the build up of soil on food contact surfaces with regular cleaning and sanitizing.

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(1)  (P) BBQ chicken is 115°F and brisket is 128°F.  Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food is not maintained at 135°F, or above. Reviewed hot holding requirements and discussed HACCP concept with employee and person in charge. Inadequately held food was discarded. Reference 3-501.16(A)(1).

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.citation_text: 3-304.14  (C) In-use wiping cloths are not stored properly. Cloths used to wipe surfaces and equipment shall be held in proper sanitizer solution between uses. In-use cloths must be laundered daily. Reference 3-304.14. Sanitizing solution for wet wiping cloths was about 100ppm of Quat. Discussed potential issues including cleaning buckets nightly, letting the sanitizer run for 5 seconds before filling the bucket and pre wetting cotton towels with quat before adding them to the bucket. The sanitizer tested at 200ppm when these items were considered.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13  (C) Soil residue present on the lid holder at the soda fountain and the soda fountain drip tray. Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation.  Reference 4-602.13. Maintain free of accumulated soil.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: Observed the ice coffee machine to have ice coffee in the tube outside of the machine. Take care to cut the tube at a 45 degree angle so that the tube drains and does not hold food at room temperature. The ice coffee machine has been placed out of service as there is a large chunck of ice on one side and not the other. Food from the sub table has been moved to the walk in. The Sub table was holding at 42F to 45F. The internal thermometer said 41F. 750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: Observed the following non food areas to be soiled: 1) containers with deli meats in the walk in cooler 2) small black fan back by donuts 3) lid holders at soda machine area.  Clean and maintain clean. 750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: Observed drawer behind sub table to be soiled with dust and other debris. Clean and maintain free of accumulated soil. 750-860 Cleaned and sanitized utensils an equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: Observed no covered cans in the restrooms. Provide covered waste receptacles. 750-1110d Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily clean able, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment: Three grossly dented cans of cheese sauce are observed to be on the shelf in the kitchen for use. The cans were removed and put to go back. Manager was directed to observe orders when they come in and send dented cans back immediately by her supervisor. 750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: Observed boxes of food on the floor in the freezer. Store all food up off of the floor. 750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: Observed two areas where cardboard boxes are used in the kitchen to hold random items. The boxes were removed and replaced with cleansable containers. 750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: Observed the nozzles on the soda fountain to be soiled. These were cleaned immediately. Also observed a fan blowing in the kitchen to be grossly soiled with hair and dust. Clean and maintain free of accumulated soil. 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use or any time they may have become contaminated.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: Observed single use items stored in various places to be unprotected. Single use containers in the shed are open. They are also stored on the floor. Single use items in the facility are stored on the floor. These were all moved up. 750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: The floor drain at the 3 part sink is soiled. Clean daily for at least 10 days with proper cleaner. 750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors and maintain free of accumulated soil.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed more than 3 bags of garbage out on the ground around the dumpster.  Keep bags picked up. Do not allow garbage to remain outside of the dumpster for any reason. 750-1350a Food service establishments and all parts of property used in connection with their operation shall be kept free of litter.  Remove all unnecessary items.
750-1160 The premises shall be kept in such a condition to prevent the harborage or feeding of insects or rodents.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed tubes from cream machine to be cut at straight angle that would not allow for draining. Food within the tubes were not under refridgeration. Keep tubes cut at 45 degree angle so that they drain properly. 
750-250  All potentially hazardous foods shall be kept at 41°F or below while on display and service.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Observed fly traps above doughnut prep area that were soiled. Fly trap was removed by employee. 
Observed plastic protective sleeve to be left around dispensing tube of cream machine. Plastic sleeve has been removed.
750-160  Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: Observed cardboard box on shelf above 3 part sink to hold clean lids. Cardboard is not considered a clean surface. Discontinue this practice and provide an easily cleanable container. 750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed two wet wiping cloths to be stored on counters or prep surfaces. Store wet wiping cloths in sanitizer between uses. 
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the following food contact surfaces to be soiled: 1) Nozzles of soda machine. 2) Water dispensing areas of coffee pots and tea maker. 3) Seals on top of ice cream machine. 4) Doughnut dough dropper. 5) Ice machine baffles. Wash, rinse, and sanitize these surfaces. Keep them free of accumulated soil.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the following non-food contact surfaces to be soiled: 1) Drip tray of soda machine. 2) Fronts of trash bin door (where the word trash is engraved). 3) Front of cream machine. 4) Fronts of cappuccino machine. 
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed a sleeve of single service clam shells on floor behind sandwich table. Observed wet wiping cloth touching the edges of a single service pizza triangle. 
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed the men's restroom to have toilet paper strewn about the floor and an overall general appearance of disarray. Ensure the bathrooms are maintained in a clean condition. Observed soil on the toilet seat as well.
750-1110d Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleanable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.

findings.title: Containers covered, adequate number, insect and rodent proof, emptied at proper intervals, clean
findings.comment:
Observed both men and women's restrooms to lack a garbage can with a covered top. Provide covered garbage cans.
750-1130a Garbage and refuse shall be kept in durable easily cleanable, insect-proof, and rodent-proof containers.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the floor under the three compartment sink to have a soiled drain. Ensure that the floor is kept clean. 
Observed coving under the three compartment sink to be pulled away from the wall. Repair or replace coving. 
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed mold on the compressor fan in the walk-in beer cooler to have a mold accumulation. Ensure that the attached equipment is maintained clean and free of accumulated soil.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.citation_text:
750.160 & 1120 - Employee was observed using a wiping cloth to dry hands after handling dishes at the wash basin of the 3 part sink. Employee was advised on proper use wiping cloths.  Wiping cloth was placed in soiled linen storage area of kitchen. Employee washed hands before returning to food prep.

Common towels are prohibited. Use only paper towels for wiping/drying hands.

Employee was also observed using a pen with gloved hands to mark on pizza slice holders and preparing to continue with portioning baked pizza slices without changing gloves. Employee was advised on proper use of gloves between tasks, and gloves were changed before continuing with food prep.
General surfaces, such as pens, are not considered clean surfaces. Once touched with gloved hands the gloves must be removed and discarded, and a new pair of gloves must be worn to continue with food prep. 

Gloves are intended for only one use. Gloves must be changed when they are soiled, torn, or there is an interruption in task

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
750.650a - Plastic ice scoop was cracked. Replace the ice scoop.

Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.citation_text:
750.820 - Sanitizer tested at 0ppm quat. Baking sheets were observed soaking in sanitizer compartment. Solution was emptied and remade at proper concentration (200ppm). Baking sheets and knife on drying rack were placed on dirty dish drain board to go through ware washing process again.

Equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4).
**Sanitizer solution must be changed as needed and more frequently depending upon use. Use test strips to check sanitizer solution and verify it is maintained at 200ppm quat throughout the day.**

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.citation_text:
750.1060 - A) Handsink between manager's office and pizza make table was soiled, had food debris in the drain, and was slow draining. Maintenance worker cleaned out the drain during the inspection. Sink drained properly once the drain was cleaned. **It is a bad practice to use handsinks for anything other than handwashing. Food and other debris can clog the drain if the handsinks are used for other tasks, such as rinsing food equipment, etc.**

B) Vacuum breaker on top of mopsink faucet leaks when water is on. Replace the vacuum breaker.

C) Ice machine drain line observed to have buildup of slime mold coming out of it (located under back left corner of the machine). Clean the plumbing and maintain clean.

All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.citation_text:
750.1170 - One of the front doors is not currently self closing. The bottom of the door is catching along the tile where it meets the threshold inside the building. Manager put a work order in with corporate to get the door repaired. **In the meantime, staff must keep an eye on the door and push the door shut whenever possible.**

Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text:
750.1220 - A) Floor drain under kitchen 3 part sink was soiled with mold/buildup. Clean the floor drain.

B) General debris was observed on the floor under the ice machine. Clean the floor under the ice machine.

Floors shall be maintained clean.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.citation_text:
750.1310 - Can of stainless steel maintainer was observed sitting on the same tray that was used to house the ice scoop on top of the ice machine. Scoop and tray were taken to dish area to go through ware washing. Stainless steel maintainer was discarded. Another bottle remained on top of the ice machine along with bottles of ice machine cleaner and frebreze. Store the aforementioned items and all chemicals away from ice scoop and tray.

All toxic items must be properly stored separate from food and all food related items (i.e. clean equipment, single service articles, etc.) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.citation_text:
750.1300 - Two spray bottles were unlabeled in the dish area. One appeared to be degreaser and the other appeared to be bleach (based on color of chemicals). Spray bottle of degreaser was labeled as to the contents. Other bottle that was said to be a bleach water solution and tested as straight bleach (inspector's test strip bleached out - strip was clear with dark purple black edge). Manager took bleach away from kitchen (no test strips to use in kitchen area).

Containers of poisonous or toxic materials necessary for the maintenance of the establishment shall be labeled in accordance with law. Maintain proper labels on all spray bottles,

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment: Personal drink (open top can) is stored on shelf above other food in the walk in cooler. 750-160  Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination. Drink was removed from the cooler.  Another personal drink in a bottle was moved to the bucket for employee items.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: A clean cutting board and the pizza cutter are stored on the back of the faucet at the 3 pan sink. 750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination. do not store clean items where they can be splashed by items being washed in the first part sink.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: Single use containers are observed to be stored on the floor next to the prep sink at the sandwich area. Also some single use lids are observed to be stored on the shelf next to a feather duster. Those lids were discarded in the garbage. 750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law. Organize the area with four cubbies/shelves under the hot holding units.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment: The first aide kit is stored on a shelf under hot holding area where single use items are also stored. 750-1310 All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all  toxic items.  Organize this area to properly protect single use items. Keep them separate from toxic items. The kit was removed to an area for non food items.
